scope: Only this advisory, for Bun 1.4.4 embedded in putgd-proton-runtime. Does not waive other advisories, other Bun versions or any Grype finding.
assessment: Not reached by put.gd. putgd-proton-runtime is a stdio JSON client of put.gd: it starts no server, accepts no connections and talks to Proton over fetch with the default HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2. No source file of the helper or of its bundled dependencies names http3, node:quic or Bun.serve; the only matches are type declarations (bun-types, @types/bun, @types/node), which bun build does not bundle. put.gd passes no Bun flags. The helper does inherit the resident's environment (ProtonProvider::helperEnvironment removes only PROTON_DRIVE_* and PUTGD_PROTON_*), and Bun 1.4.4 enables its experimental HTTP/3 fetch client when BUN_FEATURE_FLAG_EXPERIMENTAL_HTTP3_CLIENT is set or BUN_OPTIONS carries --experimental-http3-fetch. Neither is set by put.gd, its packages or any supported desktop. Setting one takes control of the user's session environment, which already means code running as the user, and the client half would then still need a malicious HTTP/3 peer at a TLS-authenticated Proton API origin; Bun has not confirmed that the client half is exploitable at all.

method.input: putgd-proton-helper-rebuild.tar.gz from the v26.1124.6905-nightly Proton corresponding source (putgd-proton-corresponding-source.tar.gz parts 1 and 2, downloaded and verified by audit_assets.py)
method.tree: build-source/: 7395 files, 5398 JavaScript or TypeScript (.js .mjs .cjs .ts .mts .cts), 18 top-level node_modules entries, including @protontech/drive-sdk and its nested node_modules
commands: grep -rn -E 'BUN_|experimental-http3|http3' src/ tools/proton/*.ts tools/proton/*.py (application launch path)
results: No file outside the type declaration packages matched.
No match: put.gd sets no Bun variable or flag; the inherited environment is described under inheritedEnvironment.
